evidence_excerpts: Results supported a model with excellent fit in which perceived ‘emotional synchrony’ with other participants—moderated by baseline scores of peer conformity—predicted subsequent changes in the NPB factor.
Figure 4. Changes in non-physicalist beliefs are moderated by baseline variables and pre-state identify fusion and mediated by acute emotional synchrony during the psychedelic session.
text: Perceived emotional synchrony during the psychedelic ceremony mediates later changes in non-physicalist beliefs, with baseline peer conformity moderating that pathway.
